note: Harness build roadmap. Managed by factory/harness/stage-manager.mjs — edit via CLI, not by hand. Each stage advances autonomously through IMPLEMENT -> SELF TEST -> INDEPENDENT REVIEW -> REPAIR -> RE-TEST -> PASS -> NEXT STAGE. Design principles: factory/harness/design-principles.md

stages.name: Codex connection / Minimal Review Loop
acceptance_criteria: Codex CLI callable from Claude Code (subscription auth, no API key)
Structured verdict JSON obtained from a real review
Timeout / unavailable / malformed handling proven
Loop engine completes PRODUCE->REVIEW->REPAIR->RE-REVIEW on a real Q1 without human checks
All runs logged under factory/state/runs/

notes.text: Codex connection proven (probe 12s, reviews 43-47s). Failure modes tested: 5 deterministic shim cases + 1 real CODEX_TIMEOUT handled without fail-open. Full autonomous PRODUCE->REVIEW->REPAIR->RE-REVIEW cycle ran twice; adapter child-process-kill bug found and fixed during the real timeout.

Design docs reviewed by Codex as independent reviewer
Two-axis QA rubric (CAREER_AUTHENTICITY x GAME_QUALITY) drafted as reviewable rules

notes.text: PASS score 98 (run-2026-09-01T23-33-01-4h3p). 15-game research corpus (codex-delegated), critic v2 rubric, difficulty taxonomy, lab structure.

stages.name: Game Researcher + Mechanics Library
acceptance_criteria: Researcher decomposes existing games into goal/core_action/information/constraints/decisions/feedback/failure/retry_motivation/mastery/variation/progression/reusable_mechanics
Mechanics stored as reusable entries (not title imitations) extending factory/taxonomy/
Library validated by scan scripts + Codex review

notes.text: PASS 98 (confirmation run gq8q iter2). 22 mechanics in 3 layers (16 challenge / 3 modifier / 3 motivation), evidence-grounded in 15-game corpus, map regenerated. Main run ehcs hit max_iterations at 84 (mapping-precision tail); fixes confirmed in follow-up run.

stages.name: Existing JIBUN CHOICE game audit
acceptance_criteria: All 39 registered Q1 games audited with CORE LOOP / MASTERY / REPLAY statements
Audit reports stored per game with Codex-confirmed verdicts
Weak games ranked for improvement queue

notes.text: Calibration decision needed before mass audits: Codex holds 'answer written in the order sheet' to be the forbidden anti-pattern, stricter than the project's C_required=partial baseline. See factory/projects/q1-improve-xray/loop-report.md HUMAN_REQUIRED section.

Calibration RESOLVED by user 2026-09-02: C_required=true is desirable; only C_alone_determines_answer=true (no player judgment left) is a quality problem. Rules updated in design-principles.md + game-critic-v2.md

39/39 audited by Codex under calibrated critic v2. avgGQ62/avgCA74. Weakest: lab_check(18), clue_board(31), line_debug(39), rx_check(42), timetable(43). 10 fake-choice flags. NOTE: current xray_shoot (bootstrap-repaired) scores GQ86/CA89 under the calibrated rubric — the old 58 was pre-calibration.

stages.name: Harness generalization
acceptance_criteria: Loop engine parameterized over arbitrary artifact types (design doc / component / data file)
Producer/reviewer roles pluggable; reviewer independence enforced structurally
